summary: fortinet.fortios in Ansible 9.12.0 made SET operations send a GET first and then PUT or POST, added the Mantis features, and added support for FortiOS 7.6.0.
questions: Why does fortios send a GET before updating an object?
Which Ansible 9 release added FOS 7.6.0 support?

answer_card.title: fortinet.fortios 9.12.0 changes
answer_card.answer_md:
In Ansible 9.12.0, `fortinet.fortios`:

- SET operations now send a **GET first**, then PUT or POST.
- Supports **FortiOS 7.6.0**.
- Includes the Mantis feature set.
